capabilities: Read the current note, a selection, or from the cursor aloud
Play every note in a folder back to back
Highlight and auto-scroll the sentence being read in a reader pane
Apply pronunciation rules and silent-symbol filtering
Cache sentence audio and export a note to MP3
extras: On Android the plugin only gives setup guidance for the system Select to Speak service, without sentence highlighting, folder playback or Edge voices. Azure keys are kept in Obsidian SecretStorage, and note text is sent to Microsoft only when an online provider is chosen.
problem: Obsidian cannot read notes aloud on its own, and Chinese-first voices, sentence tracking and folder-wide playback are missing.

relations.evidence: Install the BRAT plugin, then command palette → "BRAT: Add a beta plugin"
use their own Azure Speech Key

summary: Reads notes aloud in Traditional Chinese using offline system voices, Edge CLI or Azure, with sentence highlighting and folder playback.
